name: The Key · Church Edition
intro:
⚠️ BEFORE STEP 1 — check you are in a test copy. Look for the small “🧪 Test copy” mark on the screen. It means this app has never seen you, which is what the steps below expect. If it is missing and the app already shows your own information, you have opened your real app: go back to your list and tap this app's name again, rather than using a bookmark, your history, or an icon on your home screen. Starting in the wrong copy makes the early steps look broken when nothing is wrong.

You will write a few lines of a pretend church's Key — where the shutoff, keys and password list are — watch the ready bar fill, then reload, go offline, print and start over.

steps.do: On the welcome card at the bottom, tap “skip the tour” (small words, bottom-right).
steps.see: The card changes to “How do you want to start?” with two big buttons.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”. (If a small box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.”, tap “OK”.)
steps.see: The card closes (on a new phone the box may not come — that is fine). Near the top it says “Nothing filled in yet — start anywhere.” and the first section, “🏢 The building”, is open with an empty box.

steps.do: Tap the box under “🏢 The building” and type this line.
steps.type: Master keys: black cabinet in Pastor Dan’s office
steps.see: The top bar now says “Your Church Key: 1 of 5 sections started · 20% of the boxes filled in”, and a gold “✓ started” appears next to “🏢 The building”.

steps.do: Scroll down a little and tap the title “💻 Accounts & services”.
steps.see: It opens. The grey line says to write WHERE the password list is kept (never the passwords themselves), and there is an empty box.

steps.do: Tap that box and type this line.
steps.type: Password list: sealed envelope in the office safe
steps.see: “✓ started” appears next to “💻 Accounts & services” and the top bar says “2 of 5 sections started · 40%”.

steps.do: Tap the title “🤝 The people to call”, tap its box and type this line.
steps.see: “✓ started” appears next to it and the top bar says “3 of 5 sections started · 60%”.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The page comes back. The top bar still says “3 of 5 sections started”; the three sections you wrote in are open with your lines still there (“Master keys: black cabinet in Pastor Dan’s office”, apostrophe and all) and the two empty ones are folded. If a card “Keep The Key on your Home Screen” appears at the bottom, tap “Later”. On many Android phones it does not appear — then just go on.
steps.tip: The Home Screen card may show on a second visit; “Later” just closes it.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then tap the title “💌 Anything else they should know” and type this line in its box.
steps.type: The lockbox code changes every January
steps.see: A brown bar at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” Your line saves anyway: “✓ started” appears and the top bar says “4 of 5 sections started · 80%”.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off (the brown bar goes away). Scroll down and tap “🖨 Print my Key”.
steps.see: A print preview opens: one clean page titled “🔑 The Key · Church Edition” with today's date (“Updated …”), your lines under THE BUILDING, ACCOUNTS & SERVICES, THE PEOPLE TO CALL and ANYTHING ELSE, and a “—” under PAPERS & POLICIES. The buttons and the purple bar are not on the page. Tap Cancel.
A small box asks “Clear everything and start over?”
Nothing is erased — the top bar still says “4 of 5 sections started”.

steps.do: Tap “Start over” again, and this time tap “OK”.
steps.see: Everything is cleared: the top says “Nothing filled in yet — start anywhere.” and no section shows “✓ started”.

steps.do: Tap “🖨 Print my Key” with every section empty.
steps.see: No print preview. A small box says “Fill in at least one section first — even one line helps them someday.” Tap “OK”.

steps.do: Tap the round “?” button at the bottom-right, just above the purple bar.
steps.see: “Help and settings” opens. The top line says which version you're on (“You are on v…”). That's the end — thank you!

steps.do: Now the videos. This app has 3. Open each one and watch it right through, sound on: Explain it to me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=churchkey&mode=firsttime  Watch it work — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=churchkey  Train me — https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/watch.html?app=churchkey&mode=train
steps.see: Each one talks without stopping — no long silences, no sentence starting again. The screen behind the words changes to match what is being said, and when it points at something, that thing is really there. If a video talks about a button or a screen you did not see in this app, say so — that is a real fault and one of the most useful things you can find.

steps.do: Last, the shop page everyone sees before they buy: https://jerrywins1.github.io/daraja-apps/shop/ — find this app on its shelf and read its card.
steps.see: The name and the one-line description match the app you just used. The price says Free, with an optional donation to Loving InDeed. That is right: nothing is sold, and nobody has to give. Nothing on the card promises something the app does not do. If the card and the app disagree, the card is the fault — say which bit.
